bundles the additional non-Rust assets noted at the end. Their copyright notices

MPL-2.0, Zlib, OFL-1.1, and others).

This file covers BOTH publicly shipped builds of qnsqy: the Linux build
(deb/rpm/npm/CDN) and the Windows installer build (x86_64-pc-windows-gnu,
qnsqy-setup .exe). The crate list is the union of the dependency sets of the
two builds, so platform-specific crates (e.g. the windows-sys family on
Windows, or Linux-only crates) each appear even though any single binary
links only the subset for its platform.

This file is generated by scripts/gen-third-party-notices.sh directly from the
crate sources; it is regenerated for every release.
